text: {"name":"update_rate_info","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Looks up a rate-table record, refreshes the cached rate parameters when its low-nibble ID changes, and reports the refresh through `changed`; on lookup failure it fills the parameter block with 2627 sentinels.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"a3":"rate_info","a4":"changed","result":"rate_record","v7":"rate_id","v8":"record_word_14","v9":"record_word_10","v10":"packed_rate_values"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Repacked rate-table value decoded from record offset 14."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Repacked rate-table value decoded from record offset 10."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Pair of repacked rate-table values decoded from record offsets 18 and 22."},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Raw selector byte copied from record offset 8."},{"offset":17,"meaning":"Packed flags derived from bit 4 of several rate-table words."},{"offset":18,"meaning":"Cached low-nibble rate ID used to detect changes."}]}
